html:
SMTO-TSK-0007 — SMTO can't find this run

GUID: 64321116-44e4-400f-8e86-e7d3a20927b2
Slug: run-not-found
Domain: TSK · Subsystem: tsk

What happened

  • The run this action points to (one attempt by the Agent at a task) is no longer available. It may have been deleted along with its task or conversation, or SMTO no longer keeps its details.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the SMTO page in your browser. The page may still show a run that was deleted or replaced since it was loaded.
  2. Open the conversation from the Conversations pane and use the buttons on its most recent reply instead of an older one. Those controls belong to a run SMTO still has, so the action has something to work on.
  3. If the missing run was changing files, sending messages or using other systems, check those places yourself before asking the Agent to do the work again. A run that can't be found may still have finished some of its work outside SMTO.

What success looks like

  • The conversation shows its latest reply and the control you used works without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Remember that a missing run does not prove its work was undone, so don't assume nothing happened.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The requested run, trace, request or prepared request was not found, is tombstoned, or is no longer retained by the server.

What this means

  • The required run, trace, request header or live run-state record cannot be found or is tombstoned at the selected route. Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.

Why this can happen

  • The required run, trace, request header or live run-state record cannot be found or is tombstoned at the selected route.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the exact owning request/run and retained stores, distinguishing missing live state from a retained historical summary.

How to fix it

  • Check the request_id or run_id from Technical details against the conversation's current runs; a 404 here means the native run, trace or prepared request is missing, tombstoned or past retention. Reload the client and act on a run the conversation still lists. An unavailable run does not prove external work was undone, so verify side effects outside SMTO before submitting replacement work.
  • Refresh the owning conversation and select a retained run. An unavailable run does not prove external work was undone.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The selected supported action resolves its required retained run evidence.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
